scientific_integrity: The exact characteristic function is established prior work; new contribution is the nontrivial critical fourth-cumulant finite residual, its ratio classification, and log-squared standardized behavior. Analytical proof provided with numerical checks; no claim of independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Fixed positive rates and speed; only long-time fourth cumulant, not global finite-time sign
Uniform preferential reset of both state components, symmetric initial velocity; no general memory kernel
Publication priority may be subsumed by an unrecognized broader theorem
title: Critical fourth-cumulant cancellation in an active memory-reset walk
